To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the simulation model can be used to predict the distribution pattern of a spreading system, that the distribution pattern of spinning disc fertilizer spreader is strongly dependent on the orifice position, the orifice shape, and the angular velocity of the spreading disc, and that the distribution pattern is very sensitive to variations of the fertilizer rate.
the mathematical model of the spreading process can be used for calculating fertilizer distribution patterns from spinning disc spreaders.
the model is able to simulate the spreading pattern of spinning disc fertilizer spreader and that it can be used to predict the effect of different spreader settings on the spreading pattern.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a control system for site-specific fertilizer application by spinning disc spreaders.
a simulation model for the calculation of fertilizer distribution patterns of single and twin disc fertilizer spreaders.
the design of a control system, which will enable a site specific application of fertilizers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model can be used for the development of an efficient control system for site specific applications of fertilizer by spinning disc fertilizer broadcast spreaders.
the simulation model is an adequate and useful tool for the design and development of a spread control system.
a control system for site specific spreading is feasible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the simulation results show the possibility of a continuous manipulation of the spreader parameters, to produce a constant shape and width of the distribution patterns, for varying fertilizer rates and for a given working speed.
the simulation model can be used for a better understanding of the spreading system and for a better optimization of the spreading pattern by manipulation of spreader parameters.

a control system for site-specific fertilizer application by means of spinning disc spreaders should not only take into account the mass flow, but also the position of the orifices, the angular velocity of the spinning discs and the shape of orifices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the shape and width of a spreader pattern is very sensitive to changes of the angular velocity of a spinning disc spread.
the model can be used for the design of a spreader pattern control system.
the model can be used as a tool to simulate and design spreader patterns for site-specific applications, which is essential for an effective spreader control system.
